decks.notes: This deck aims to quickly assemble the combo of Doomsday and Thassa's Oracle to win the game in a single turn. The deck revolves around using efficient card selection spells like Brainstorm and Preordain to find key pieces, while also protecting the combo with countermagic like Force of Will and Flusterstorm. Rituals such as Dark Ritual help generate extra mana to cast Doomsday and other spells in the same turn. The deck also includes powerful tutors like Demonic Tutor and Vampiric Tutor to find missing combo pieces quickly and efficiently.

The deck focuses on utilizing artifact mana acceleration and card draw spells to quickly assemble a combo involving Paradoxical Outcome and powerful artifacts such as Bolas's Citadel and Time Vault. This allows the player to generate a large amount of mana and draw through their deck rapidly, ultimately winning the game through a storm combo or locking the opponent out with cards like Karn, the Great Creator and Narset, Parter of Veils. The deck aims to win the game quickly and efficiently through a high-powered combo engine.

The deck is focused on utilizing the powerful combo of Paradoxical Outcome with various mana acceleration cards such as Moxen and Mana Vault to generate massive amounts of card advantage and mana to overwhelm the opponent. The deck also includes key pieces such as Tinker, Bolas's Citadel, and Time Vault to provide alternate win conditions or additional card advantage. Control elements like Force of Will and Teferi, Time Raveler help protect the combo pieces while Narset, Parter of Veils and Monastery Mentor provide additional value and control options. The deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent before they can mount a defense.

The deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with creatures like Basking Rootwalla, Bloodghast, and Vengevine to bring them back to the battlefield with cards like Hogaak, Arisen Necropolis and Hollow One. It also disrupts opponents' strategies with cards like Collector Ouphe and Force of Vigor while utilizing strong mana acceleration from Deathrite Shaman and Once Upon a Time. The deck utilizes Bazaar of Baghdad for card advantage and discard, allowing for explosive starts and overwhelming aggression to quickly overpower opponents in a Vintage 1 vs 1 format.

This deck focuses on using a combination of powerful one-drop spells and disruptive creatures to control the game while applying pressure. It leverages efficient card draw and graveyard manipulation to outvalue opponents, while also utilizing proactive hate cards like Collector Ouphe to disrupt opposing strategies. The deck aims to control the board early on with cheap counterspells and removal, and then close out the game with resilient threats like Tarmogoyf and Elvish Reclaimer. It also utilizes the companion Lurrus of the Dream-Den to provide additional value and flexibility throughout the game.

This Vintage 1 vs 1 Aggro - MUD deck focuses on utilizing artifacts with low mana costs to quickly overwhelm the opponent. Cards like Foundry Inspector and Stonecoil Serpent allow for fast plays, while cards such as Sphere of Resistance and Thorn of Amethyst slow down the opponent's strategy. The deck also includes powerful artifacts like Karn, the Great Creator and Mystic Forge for late-game advantage. By combining artifact synergy with disruptive elements, this deck aims to control the board and pressure the opponent into submission.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly establish board presence and disrupt the opponent's game plan with a combination of efficient creatures and disruptive spells. With a mix of powerful mana acceleration cards and versatile control elements, the deck aims to apply pressure and control the tempo of the game. The inclusion of equipment like Kaldra Compleat and Sword of Fire and Ice enhances the aggression of the deck, while cards like Flusterstorm and Hullbreacher help to protect its own game plan and disrupt the opponent's strategy.

The deck is focused on playing artifacts that disrupt the opponent's game plan while also aggressively attacking with creatures like Arcbound Ravager and Walking Ballista. It aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent with powerful artifacts like Nettlecyst and Walking Ballista, while also using cards like Chalice of the Void and Sphere of Resistance to hinder the opponent's strategies. The deck also includes powerful mana acceleration cards like Mishra's Workshop and Moxen to help cast expensive cards like Karn, the Great Creator and Mystic Forge. The deck's strategy revolves around efficiently deploying threats and disrupting the opponent's resources.

This deck focuses on utilizing cheap spells and efficient creatures to quickly apply pressure on the opponent. It aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan with counter magic and removal spells while drawing cards to maintain card advantage. The deck also utilizes powerful cards like Treasure Cruise, Ancestral Recall, and Time Walk to gain additional resources and tempo advantage. The aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dreadhorde Arcanist are accompanied by disruptive threats like Hullbreacher to control the pace of the game and secure a quick victory.

The deck focuses on assembling a combination of cards to win the game in one explosive turn. It utilizes cards like Doomsday and Thassa's Oracle to manipulate the top of the library, allowing the player to win the game instantly. The deck also includes various tutors, counterspells, and card draw spells to help find and protect the combo pieces. With efficient mana acceleration and careful planning, the deck aims to quickly set up and execute its game-winning combo.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through a combination of powerful disruption spells like Force of Will and Flusterstorm, along with creatures like Collector Ouphe to shut down opponent's artifacts. The deck also utilizes powerful card draw spells like Ancestral Recall and Dig Through Time to maintain card advantage. The key strategy revolves around resolving Standstill to slow down the game while taking advantage of powerful land utility from cards like Urza's Saga and Elvish Reclaimer to create a dominant board state. Additionally, utilizing Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion offers additional card advantage and resilience.

This deck utilizes the powerful combo potential of Underworld Breach, allowing the player to cast spells from their graveyard repeatedly to overwhelm the opponent. The deck includes a variety of card draw spells, counterspells, and tutors to ensure consistency in setting up the combo. It also includes cards like Time Walk and Tinker to generate additional value and win conditions. With efficient mana acceleration from cards like Black Lotus and Moxen, as well as land tutors like Urza's Saga, this deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and dominate the game.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize the Dredge mechanic to quickly fill the graveyard with powerful creatures like Golgari Grave-Troll and Narcomoeba. By constantly dredging and cycling through the graveyard, the deck aims to swarm the board with creatures like Hollow One and Prized Amalgam. With the ability to recur creatures from the graveyard and disrupt opponent's strategies with cards like Grief and Force of Will, this combo-oriented deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and win the game through sheer graveyard recursion and explosive creature plays.

The deck focuses on assembling the combo of Underworld Breach with cards like Brain Freeze and Predict to mill the opponent's library. It utilizes powerful card draw and manipulation spells like Ancestral Recall and Ponder to find key pieces quickly. It includes disruption spells like Force of Will and Pyroblast to protect the combo and control the opponent's plays. The deck also utilizes efficient mana acceleration with Moxen and fast mana to power out its combo quickly. Overall, the strategy revolves around comboing off quickly and efficiently while controlling the opponent's game plan.

This deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with cards like Golgari Grave-Troll and Stinkweed Imp, triggering abilities like Dredge and bringing back powerful creatures like Ichorid and Narcomoeba to overwhelm the opponent. By using cards like Cabal Therapy and Force of Will for disruption, as well as Creeping Chill for direct damage, the player aims to establish a strong board presence and outpace the opponent's strategy. With Bazaar of Baghdad as a key card for card selection and graveyard filling, the deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces for a powerful win condition.

The deck focuses on quickly deploying threats like Murktide Regent, Ragavan, and Brazen Borrower while disrupting the opponent with cards like Force of Will, Pyroblast, and Flusterstorm. It also utilizes powerful card draw and selection spells like Ancestral Recall, Dig Through Time, and Expressive Iteration to maintain tempo and card advantage. The mana base includes fetchlands, dual lands, and utility lands like Mystic Sanctuary and Strip Mine to ensure smooth and consistent mana development. The overall strategy is to apply pressure early and protect its threats while controlling the opponent's game plan.
